label: brushColorSwapsRedBlue: a picked hex color becomes a brush color edit with red and blue swapped
hexOutSwapsGreenBlue: the brush color shows in the color row with green and blue swapped
find: var hex: HexColor { HexColor(red, green, blue) }
replace: var hex: HexColor { HexColor(red, blue, green) }

label: barSkipsOptions: the tool options bar stops reading the toolOptions facet, so a brush-size step leaves its Size row stale
barReadsGiven: the bar shows the workspace the editor handed it, never the session's, so a size step the window skips never reaches it
paintFollowsEraser: the bar's color reads the active tool's options, so with the eraser picked it shows the eraser's unused color, not the paint color
